intro: Your published section is on the left. The new version, now in the article as a candidate, is on the right. Highlighted words are what changed from the published text. Paragraph numbers are the page's: the chart counts as P5.

Pangram's web app: the whole section reads 100% Human ("Human Written", 907 words scanned, 03:32 UTC, batch 259g), and every paragraph passes alone or in a run with a neighbor that passes alone. My calls across the section's 245 checks: 71% right on pass or no pass (saying "fails" every time would have been 47%).

How it was made: my rewording of the published text read 100% AI, while Emulate's outputs read Human. So the base is Emulate's wording, with your meaning put back one change at a time. Then came five rounds of reviewers (traces, cold reads, the stance check), and each fix was checked on Pangram again.
Two questions for you on OWNER-QUESTIONS.md: 17, your published "outside review" in P16; and 18, P12's "the same need" against your chart, which shows five in crisis among eighty.
